parts.label: e
parts.text: (e) A student suggests precautions to take in this experiment to obtain reliable results. Tick one box to indicate the most sensible suggestion. Carry out the experiment in a darkened room. Use pins that are taller than the height of the block. View the bases of the pins. View the pins with one eye closed. [1]
